(1) plugins/section-view/src/tool.ts is the only production dispatcher of section.create, and grep -rn 'new SectionTool' across apps/packages/plugins (excluding node_modules and __tests__) -> 0 hits outside its own docstring: nothing ever constructs it. So tools/ga-gate/check-tool-activator-coverage.ts counts section-view COVERED on the NAME of a registration, never its reachability -- and the reachability test's own header (sectionViewReachableThroughComposedRuntime.test.ts:43-52) records exactly this, self-corrected: 'This paragraph first read section-view has no tool activator at all. That is false, and the truth is worse (L-9923).' (3) apps/editor/src/engine/views/plantools/SectionPlanToolHandler.ts:126 dispatches 'section.mark.create' -- the section-MARK ANNOTATION, a different key, and :122-123 says so explicitly. No production path reaches section.create.
